decision.reason: [ev-ad7162c77c9e] is only the title of a PR in a release-notes list: "remove days from refreshInterval docs", with a link to PR #4601. It doesn't say which resource kinds own refreshInterval or whether a 'd'/days unit was ever accepted, is now rejected, or still parses. It also doesn't say whether the edited docs are CRD field descriptions or website docs. The excerpt sits under a "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed" locator, so we can't safely assume this is docs-only either. We need the PR content or the changed docs and schema to write the subject, change and applicability.
